description: Change a client review link’s expiry or responsive previews, or revoke/restore access. Supply only fields to change. Revoked or expired links stop scheduled reminders. This does not mark a reviewer done or change issue status.

context.description: One sentence on why you are calling this tool, for OverlayQA product analytics. Describe the purpose only (for example "checking the checkout page for contrast issues"). Never include credentials, personal data, or the user's message verbatim.

expiresAt.description: Expiry as an ISO-8601 UTC instant

reviewId.description: Client review UUID from list_client_reviews; not the public link token

name: update_client_review
